**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, Virginia, a $2.1 million federal DOT public safety grant was announced and a women’s addiction recovery residence is scheduled to open by year-end. In Mercer County, West Virginia, a Princeton police lieutenant was arrested on arson charges tied to a structure fire, while four men face child exploitation charges in a sting spanning Wyoming and McDowell counties; early voting turnout is rising in both Mercer and Tazewell. No active NWS alerts or major road closures reported in the core area.

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Princeton, Mercer County, WV** — A Princeton police lieutenant was arrested on arson charges by West Virginia State Fire Marshals in connection with a structure fire. Multiple outlets reported the arrest on or around October 28, 2026. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://woay.com/princeton-police-officer-arrested-for-arson/) [source](https://www.lootpress.com/southern-west-virginia-police-lieutenant-arrested-in-connection-with-structure-fire/) [source](https://news.google.)
